resources.content:
# cert-manager resources

Place the non-secret cert-manager resources managed by Fleet in this directory, for
example ClusterIssuers and test Certificates.

The Cloudflare API token must be supplied as a secret through a secret-management process
or applied separately. Do not commit the token to this directory.

The existing files in `../../../../cert-manager/` are retained as migration references for
now. They are not automatically included in this Fleet bundle.
resources.name: README.md

resources.content:
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata:
  name: letsencrypt
spec:
  acme:
    email: dobrowolski.nowakowski@gmail.com
    server: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
    privateKeySecretRef:
      name: le-prod-issuer-acct-key
    solvers:
      - dns01:
          cloudflare:
            email: dobrowolski.nowakowski@gmail.com
            apiTokenSecretRef:
              name: cloudflare-api-token-secret
              key: api-token
        selector:
          dnsZones:
            - rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
            - '*.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl'
            - proxmox3.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
            - proxmox4.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
            - rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
            - '*.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl'
            - proxmox3.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
            - proxmox4.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: ClusterIssuer
metadata:
  name: letsencrypt-stag
spec:
  acme:
    email: dobrowolski.nowakowski@gmail.com
    server: https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
    privateKeySecretRef:
      name: le-issuer-acct-key
    solvers:
      - dns01:
          cloudflare:
            email: dobrowolski.nowakowski@gmail.com
            apiTokenSecretRef:
              name: cloudflare-api-token-secret
              key: api-token
        selector:
          dnsZones:
            - rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
            - '*.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl'
            - rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
            - '*.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl'
resources.name: clusterissuers.yaml
